sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: EU ministers mull new ways to curb irregular migration
items.description: The proposals include setting up so-called return hubs outside the EU and strengthening the border agency Frontex. Greece has even proposed temporarily suspending asylum applications in emergency situations.

items.title: Germany expresses optimism over Montenegro's EU ambitions
items.description: Germany's top diplomat said Montenegro has made "remarkable progress" in the accession process. The small Balkan state is being seen as a frontrunner among six regional candidates.

items.title: Germany news: Merz lauds NATO with Westphalian Peace Prize
items.description: At a ceremony to honor NATO, the German chancellor warned that Russia will threaten the rest of Europe if it isn't stopped in Ukraine. In other news, the German military will set up its first drone regiment.

items.title: On October 3, Latvians will elect a new parliament ― with Russia looming large over the campaign
items.description: On October 3, Latvians will elect a new parliament with Russia looming large over the campaign. Security fears dominate the agenda, but so does a debate over the economic cost of cutting ties with Moscow.
